secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY

secrets.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk secret key (sk_test_... or sk_live_...) from https://dashboard.clerk.com/last-active?path=api-keys

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_S3_BUCKET_NAME
secrets.description: AWS S3 bucket name for PDF uploads (AWS S3 console)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_S3_BUCKET_REGION
secrets.description: AWS S3 bucket region e.g. us-east-1 (AWS S3 console)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
secrets.description: AWS S3 access key ID (AWS IAM console)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY_ID
secrets.description: AWS S3 secret access key (AWS IAM console)

secrets.name: PINECONE_INDEX
